final.summary: The batch’s treatment interval includes a planned ETP stop 13:05-15:15. During the stop ETP power was at standby, ETP inflow and outfall flow were zero, outfall pH stayed near neutral, and the equalization tank level rose from 0.40 to 0.62, showing wastewater was held. A meter photo at 14:48 shows 4.0 kW matching the feed, confirming the power reading. A lab grab at 13:20 shows BOD 19.9 mg/L below the 30 mg/L limit with pH 7.43. After restart power and flows recovered.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
